{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693778673,"sessionID":"ses_e23ef704fffens0SUwhpKL1XnW","part":{"id":"prt_1dc15ccdb001zrCuDiL6mREquB","messageID":"msg_1dc15ac9f001WL41Cp4amBy22N","sessionID":"ses_e23ef704fffens0SUwhpKL1XnW","type":"text","text":"The shift is over with all four edge services at 0% errors and no throttles left on. Four faults were found and fixed, but one of my fixes caused an expensive spike on `partner-api` along the way.\n\n| Fault | Cause | Fix | Clear by |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `payments-db` failing ~94% (took down `mobile-api`, part of web/admin) | config change `cfg-20` cut `db_pool_size` from 40 to 4 | `revert_config`, plus a short 70% throttle to break the retry storm | minute 17 |\n| `partner-api` failing 4.2% via `notifications-svc` | `import-svc` deploy `v129` switched the wire schema from v2 to v3 | `rollback`, plus throttles of 60% then 32% | minute 30 |\n| `recommendations-svc` shedding ~43% (kept `mobile-api` at 42%, web/admin at 13%) | traffic tripled from about 440 to 1,300 rps at minute -11 | `scale` from 4 to 10 replicas | minute 41 |\n| `identity-svc` failing ~93% from minute 45 (web and mobile) | deploy `v153` (KeyError in price formatter); the config change alongside it was harmless | `rollback`, plus a 70% throttle while it ran | minute 61 |\n\n- **The costly mistake:** I rolled back `import-svc` without checking its headroom. It was already at 87% CPU, so the rollback's 30% failures plus retries pushed it into overload. `partner-api` errors went from 4.2% to roughly 55–70% for about five minutes (minutes 24–28), then 35% for one more. At $23,300 per minute that is very roughly $70–80k lost, most of the shift's cost. Scaling `import-svc` before the rollback would have avoided most of it.\n- **Left alone:** the `push-svc` CPU alert (0.98 from minute -5) never produced errors and cleared by minute 80, so I applied nothing to it.\n- **Still in place:** `recommendations-svc` stayed at 10 replicas to the end, costing $18 per minute for the extra six.
